name: Mini Characters
creator: Kenney
notes: 12 rigged characters with walking, idle, sitting and wheelchair animations, plus mobility and medical accessories. A resting pose for the bed needs to be created. GLB and FBX included.

name: Furniture Kit
creator: Kenney
notes: 140 beds, chairs, cabinets and other furniture pieces. Add rails, wheels and a blanket to adapt an ordinary bed for the ward.

name: Building Kit
creator: Kenney
notes: 80 modular building pieces for walls, doors and adjoining rooms. Useful for expanding the hospital beyond a single room.

name: Hospital Bed
creator: Logan S.
license: CC Attribution (retain creator credit, source and license)
notes: A hospital bed with 1k textures. Check the available download formats before importing it into the game.

name: ECG Monitor
creator: demagdev
notes: A static ECG monitor with 14.6k triangles. Animate the screen separately and recolor the casing to match the ward.

name: IV Stand
creator: teeart
notes: A static IV stand with 5.1k triangles. Fit the hanging bag and tubing to your patient and bed.

name: Medical_ Ventilator
creator: Dawn
notes: A detailed ventilator with 66.9k triangles. Simplify it for browser use, then fit tubing and a mask to the patient.

name: Doctor's Office - Assets
creator: Evan Petrov
notes: A collection of medical props including an IV, stethoscope, cabinet, bandages, syringe and tray. Import just the objects the ward needs.

name: Mixamo
creator: Adobe
license: Royalty-free use in personal, commercial and nonprofit games; not CC0
notes: A free humanoid animation library and auto-rigger. Use matching character and animation files; another rig may need retargeting. Adobe ID required.
